evaluation_procedure_001.evidence: The process for placing teachers on a District Improvement or an Intensive Evaluation Plan... Concerns regarding the teacher’s performance may come about as result of formal observations, walkthroughs, drop –ins, or other evidence of teaching problems.

evaluation_system_002.evidence: Educators will be evaluated each year of service as an educator as per Public Education Department regulations.

evaluation_observation_count_003.evidence: Educators have the right to request an alternative observer from the District for one of the two formal observations.
